caption:
Korean Fried Egg Rice
high protein | 15 minute meal | fried eggs | lazy breakfast | lunch option 

Nutrition: 
C: 22 | F: 10 | P: 16
Calories: 260 per serve ( without rice ) : 469 ( with rice ) 
Serves 1

Ingredients
1/4 tsp sesame oil
2-3 garlic cloves, minced
1/2 onion, thinly sliced
2 eggs

garnish
1 spring onion green, chopped
sesame seeds

sauce: 
1/2 tbsp gochujang 
1/2 tbsp light soy sauce or 1/2 tsp dark soy + 1/2 tsp water
1/2 tsp vinegar
2-3 tbsp water 
1 tsp chilli oil or chilli flakes or gochugara

1 cup cooked white rice

Method 
add oil to a pan 
add in the garlic and onions, cook till translucent 
while thats cooking, combine all ingredients for the sauce and mix well till they form a smooth consistency, set aside 
crack in the eggs on top of the onions and spread them out to cover evenly let it cook for a minute then add in the sauce and let it reduce as the eggs cook 
you can either cook till the yolks are still runny or cooked through depending on what you prefer 
top with spring onion greens and sesame seeds then place on top of a bed of hot rice and mix together and enjoy!!!
